picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the very first DOE Genesis Mission awards signals a major new federal push to use AI for accelerating scientific discovery, from particle physics data streams to broader research infrastructure — a bellwether for how national labs and universities will partner under this initiative.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub at Cambridge combining stem cell models with AI could meaningfully speed up early-stage drug development, one of the largest single AI-adjacent funding commitments of the week.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-backed PARADIGM system, built with Mayo Clinic and the University of Florida, shows AI moving into direct, real-time clinical guidance for procedures like blood draws and intubation — a tangible healthcare application with a strong federal-academic-industry partnership behind it.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: RoboDojo, built by HKU with nearly 20 global universities including Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes a new standardized benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability — the kind of shared infrastructure that can accelerate progress across the whole field.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's use of generative AI to design entirely novel proteins, extending Nobel laureate David Baker's computational protein engineering work, represents a genuine scientific advance with implications for medicine and biotechnology.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial tumor proteomics could improve prediction of cancer treatment response across many tumor types, an example of AI foundation models delivering concrete clinical research value.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: A university-born startup, FastFlowLM, joining semiconductor giant AMD shows academic AI research translating directly into commercial chip technology for running large language models more efficiently.
picks.title: URI professors’ startup team joined semiconductor giant AMD

picks.editorial_note: A DOE Genesis Mission grant to secure the AI systems running America's electric grid against adversarial attacks addresses a critical infrastructure vulnerability with national security implications.
picks.title: DOE Funds U of A Research to Safeguard the AI Behind America's Electric Grid

picks.editorial_note: A $12 million Army Research Laboratory grant to Penn State for animal-inspired sensing in autonomous drones and robots reflects continued significant defense investment in AI-powered field robotics.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: Jefferson Lab's deployable machine learning framework for predicting fusion tokamak behavior tackles a hard science problem central to making fusion energy practical, pairing AI with a high-stakes energy technology.
picks.title: Blending Fusion Science, AI to Predict DIII-D Tokamak Behavior
